protocol.entry: 7-day mean >30-day mean, close >=30-day mean, close <=98% of 24-hour mean
protocol.exit: 7-day mean <=30-day mean, close <30-day mean, close <=95% of entry fill, or close >=106% of entry fill
protocol.screen: profit >max(0, same-budget hold profit); at least 10 completed sales; observed account drawdown <=5% in each period

limitations: Sixth hypothesis, developed after viewing the earlier five failures. Repeated research can overfit; historical screening is not proof of future income. Reserved strategy results never select or change these rules. Each period starts in cash; earlier observations warm indicators only. Profit includes net liquidation value of unsold BTC. Fees/slippage included; taxes, GIS, CAD conversion and cash interest excluded. Stop trigger does not cap losses during gaps/outages or adverse fills. The $150 entry budget does not cap cumulative losses over repeated trades.
